The dsh-TUI box: a minimal Fedora base composing the nodejs layer, the
check-keepalive holder, and the local dsh-tui candy (which composes the
`dsh` CLI candy). The npm builder installs @deepseek-ai/dsh 0.2.0-rc.2
and @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui 0.13.0 globally; the candy adds the
plugin to the `dsh-tui` profile and publishes a typed terminal channel.
The baked checks run in BOTH contexts: `charly check box dsh-tui-app`
proves the CLI + plugin install and the node floor without deploying,
and `charly check live` / `charly check run` re-prove the same shape
against the running pod plus the terminal channel.

## Composition

This box composes:

- `@github.com/opencharly/layer-nodejs:v2026.272.0322`
- `@github.com/opencharly/pod-check-keepalive:v2026.274.0621`
- `dsh-tui`
